blind_request: Request archived strains/populations with generation, lineage and treatment metadata only. Do not request or inspect MIC/antibiotic susceptibility outcomes. Generate the target MIC measurements prospectively after public registration.

strategy: Fastest strict route: select archived history-bearing material using metadata only, publicly register the frozen MIC prediction, then generate new MIC outcomes after registration. Existing susceptibility outcomes remain forbidden.
